instructions: Whisk together the olive oil, honey, mustard, garlic powder, salt, pepper, onion powder, parsley, and jerusalem mix in a bowl until combined.

Add the pargiot to a shallow dish or zip-top bag, pour the marinade over, and turn to coat well. Cover and refrigerate — marinate as long as possible, per the card (this is inactive time, not counted in prep or cook).
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with a thin film of oil. Working in batches if needed, sear the pargiot 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
notes: Honey: card says 1/4 C, amended in blue ink to 2 1/2 tbsp — used the amended amount (flagged for review). Mustard's 'grey poupon-mild or coarse…' is cut off in the photo.
